title: Aggron: Aggressive Compression of Agentic KV Caches during Head-of-Line Stalls in the Request Queue
summary: Aggron replaces threshold-triggered, bulk asynchronous context summarization with per-turn selective KV cache summarization scheduled into a separate queue that consumes idle compute and memory created by head-of-line stalls in the main request queue. The cost is substantial serving-stack complexity: a second queue, a predictor that issues summarizations only if they finish before the stalled request executes, and continuous per-turn summarization overhead, none of which is available in off-the-shelf engines or hosted APIs. It can fail when the completion-time predictor mispredicts (wasted summarization compute or late compression), at low load where head-of-line stalls are rare, or if selective summarization discards context the agent later needs, degrading accuracy on long-horizon tasks.
rationale: The idea is sound but it requires modifying the serving engine's scheduler with a separate summarization queue and completion-time prediction, which is beyond what a small team on one GPU or third-party APIs can deploy today.

claims.statement: Aggron replaces threshold-triggered, bulk asynchronous context summarization with per-turn selective KV cache summarization scheduled into a separate queue that consumes idle compute and memory created by head-of-line stalls in the main request queue. The cost is substantial serving-stack complexity: a second queue, a predictor that issues summarizations only if they finish before the stalled request executes, and continuous per-turn summarization overhead, none of which is available in off-the-shelf engines or hosted APIs. It can fail when the completion-time predictor mispredicts (wasted summarization compute or late compression), at low load where head-of-line stalls are rare, or if selective summarization discards context the agent later needs, degrading accuracy on long-horizon tasks.
At high load, reduces P99 program latency by 27-31% and raises throughput by 1.34-1.40x versus state-of-the-art asynchronous summarization.
